OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

## Summary

The requirement: on owner creation, assign `customerCode` formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` — `LAST3` = upper-cased first three letters of `lastName`, `NNNN` = a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current owner count (e.g. `SMI-0007`).

**Changes:**

1. **`Owner` entity** (`model/Owner.java`) — added a `customerCode` field mapped to a `customer_code` column, plus getter/setter.

2. **Schema** — added `customer_code` to the `owners` table in all four DB schemas (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`). The acceptance test runs on the `hsqldb` profile with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema.sql change is what makes the column exist.

3. **OpenAPI** (`openapi.yml`) — added a `readOnly` `customerCode` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field and MapStruct maps it by name (no mapper change needed).

4. **New OfficeFloor function** `AssignCustomerCode` — reads the built `@Val Owner`, computes `LAST3` (guarding against short names) and `count + 1` via `ownerRepository.findAll().size()`, and sets the code with `String.format("%s-%04d", …)`.

5. **Pipeline wiring** (`owners.POST.yml`) — inserted an `assignCode` step between `build` and `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`, so the code is assigned in-place on the entity before it's persisted.
